canonical_name: Friedrichs inequality for compactly supported Sobolev functions (exact variant open)
literal_source_claim_en: An estimate for compactly supported Sobolev functions.
statement_blocker: The catalogue omits the formula, primary source, domain, dimension, measure, Sobolev model, exponent range, compact-support or zero-trace convention, derivative, norms, constant dependencies, ordered binders, and boundary cases. A secondary source points to a 1928 gravitation article as its historical reference, conflicting with the catalogue's 1929 date and not visibly matching the modern Sobolev gloss. The catalogue also repeats the same attribution, date, and gloss as THM-M-1240. Selecting a standard formulation now would invent or substitute mathematics and could duplicate another target.
domain_and_universes: Open: an accepted source must fix the scalar field, finite-dimensional or general ambient space, dimension, domain and regularity, measure, Sobolev or smooth function model, exponent data, and all Lean universes and typeclass assumptions.
conclusion: Prospective family only: a source-specified L^p quantity of a compactly supported, zero-trace, or otherwise normalized Sobolev function is bounded by a source-specified constant times a derivative or gradient quantity, possibly with a boundary term. Exact operands, exponents, constant, and binders are open.
